title: Constructibility is independent of the constant-module encoding
statement: Let T be any scheme, B a finite commutative ring and F a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf B_T. The intrinsic predicate IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf T B F [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] holds if and only if the fixed-module sheaf obtained by restriction [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-module-encoding] is ProEtale.IsConstructible (ULift B), using a finite global stratification whose restrictions have finite constant models. The zero ring and empty scheme are included, and no affine-local substitute for global stratification is made.

proof.text: On each slice, restrict along the localized constant-section map; local bijectivity is preserved. Restriction is fully faithful. Compare the module sheafification of the constant module presheaf with the fixed-module constant sheaf using the transposed module-sheafification unit. This comparison is locally bijective, hence an isomorphism. Transport the given coverwise trivializations in both directions to identify local constancy.

For geometric stalks, the additive diagram is unchanged. The forgetful functor from modules to abelian groups preserves the filtered colimit defining the geometric stalk. Its canonical colimit isomorphism identifies the two underlying sets, so finiteness is equivalent.

Finite scheme-pullback models give slice local constancy and finite geometric stalks by the two finite-model lemmas. Conversely use finite_models_of_fixed_lisse to recover finite scheme-pullback models from slice local constancy and finite stalks. Thus fixed finite local constancy is equivalent to the intrinsic local condition after restriction.

Use canonical pullback compatibility to transport this equivalence to every immersed stratum. In both directions keep the original stratification. A zero-stratum fixed-module partition forces T empty by its covering condition; replace it with the one-stratum identity partition. On an empty base every sheaf has finite local models on the empty pro-etale covering. This enforces positivity of the intrinsic stratum count.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleModuleRestriction_constructible_iff (T : Scheme.{u})
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (F : proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T B)) :
    IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf T B F ↔
      ProEtale.IsConstructible (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)
        ((proEtaleModuleRestriction T B).obj F)
